stimulus.title: Local history archive
stimulus.text: Westhaven Museum opened a small digital archive in January after volunteers scanned photographs, maps, and handwritten records donated by local families. Visitors can search the archive for free in the museum reading room, but the images are not yet available for unrestricted download. Staff say the archive is intended to make fragile material easier to study without repeated handling of the originals. The museum has not calculated whether digitisation has reduced storage costs. A project note states that schools may use selected archive images in classroom activities with attribution. It does not claim that digital copies are more historically reliable than the original documents. The curator believes similar small museums can begin useful digitisation projects without buying specialist scanning equipment immediately.
